MOES 1001.title: Introduction to Modern Social Theories
MOES 1001.description: This course primarily teaches the fundamental principles that reflect the Marxist world view and methodology. It aims to help students deeply comprehend and accurately grasp the essential nature and holistic characteristics of Marxism. By mastering the Marxist positions, viewpoints, and methods running through these principles, students will enhance their ability to analyze the world using Marxist theory. This will strengthen their understanding of the laws governing human social development—particularly the laws of socialist development with Chinese characteristics—and help them establish both the lofty ideal of communism and the common ideal of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Grading Basis: Pass/Fail

MOES 1002.title: Society and Public Policy in Contemporary China
MOES 1002.description:
This curriculum centers on the most recent achievements in the Party's theoretical innovation, alongside the dynamic practices inherent to the development of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era. It systematically expounds upon Marxist perspectives regarding situational analysis and policy formulation, the Party's overarching lines, principles, and policies, fundamental national conditions, the evolving international landscape, and the attendant contemporary issues of significance and complexity. 
This curriculum aims to facilitate students' accurate comprehension of contemporary Chinese Marxism and a profound appreciation of the historic achievements, opportunities, and challenges confronting the Party and the state;to guide university students toward a correct cognition of the following paradigms: the overarching trends in global and Chinese development; the distinct characteristics of China subjected to international comparison; the responsibilities of the era and historical missions; and the dialectical relationship between lofty aspirations and pragmatic endeavors. Grading Basis: Pass/ Fail

MOES 1003.title: Ideological and Moral Cultivation and Legal Basis
MOES 1003.description:
Deliver instruction on Marxist worldviews regarding life, values, ethics, and the rule of law, as well as the relationship between the core socialist values and the construction of a socialist country governed by law. This aims to help students solidify their ideals and beliefs, foster and practice core socialist values, inherit traditional Chinese virtues, promote the Chinese spirit, respect and uphold the authority of the Constitution and laws, and enhance their 
ideological, moral, and legal literacy. Grading Basis: Pass/ Fail

MOES 1004.title: Chinese Culture and Modern China
MOES 1004.description: This course primarily covers the history of the Chinese nation's endeavors since modern times to achieve national independence, the liberation of the people, national prosperity, and the well-being of the populace. It aims to help students understand the history of the Party, the history of the nation, and fundamental national conditions, thereby gaining a profound appreciation of the historical imperative behind the people's choice of Marxism, the Communist Party of China, the socialist path, and the reform and opening-up policy. Grading Basis: Pass/ Fail

MOES 1005.title: Contemporary Chinese Society and Thought II
MOES 1005.description:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to General Secretary Xi Jinping's major expositions and strategic guidance across various fields, including the economy, politics, the rule of law, science and technology, culture, education, people's livelihood, ethnic affairs, religion, society, ecological civilization, national security, national defense and the military, "One Country, Two Systems" and national reunification, the united front, foreign affairs, and 
Party building.
The course aims to guide students in establishing the common ideal of socialism with Chinese characteristics and in deeply understanding the significant importance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the action guide for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Grading Basis: Pass/ Fail

MOES 1006.title: Contemporary Chinese Society and Thought I
MOES 1006.description: This course is designed to provide a systematic and comprehensive understanding of China's modern and contemporary historical trajectory. It aims to cultivate a rigorous historical consciousness and a deep appreciation for the fundamental laws governing social development. The curriculum emphasizes the critical analysis of historical inevitability, particularly regarding the "Four Choices" made by history and the people. Students will be equipped to establish a scientific view of history, enabling them to effectively critique historical nihilism. Furthermore, the course fosters the inheritance of revolutionary traditions and the Chinese spirit, ultimately strengthening the student's sense of historical mission and commitment to the great rejuvenation of the nation. Grading Basis: Pass/ Fail

MOES 1007.title: Introduction to Chinese Culture
MOES 1007.description: This course aims to help international students develop a systematic understanding of Chinese civilization—its historical evolution, traditional cultural core, and contemporary development. Through field-based practice, students will build an objective, multi‑dimensional, and authentic perception of China, while enhancing their cross‑cultural communication skills for effective study and life in China. Grade Pass/Fail.

MOES 5001.title: The Theory and Practice of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics in The New Era
MOES 5001.description: It provides thematic instruction on major issues concerning the theory and practice of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era, helping students further master the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, deepen their understanding of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and strengthen their faith in Marxism, their conviction in socialism with Chinese characteristics, and their confidence in realizing the Chinese Dream of national rejuvenation. Grading Basis: Pass/Fail

MOES 5002.title: Introduction to Natural Dialectics
MOES 5002.description: This course introduces the object, nature, content, and scope of the dialectics of nature, elaborates on its establishment and development process, and focuses on analyzing the intrinsic relationship between the dialectics of nature and the development of science and technology. It clarifies its status and role in modern scientific and technological research, as well as its significance in China's modernization drive. The course guides students to master the dialectical materialist view of nature, science, and technology, understand the general laws governing the development of nature and science and technology, recognize the role of science and technology in social development, and cultivate students' innovative spirit and ability. Grading Basis: Pass/Fail

MOES 5003.title: Introduction to Chinese Culture
MOES 5003.description: This course aims to help international students develop a systematic understanding of Chinese civilization—its historical evolution, traditional cultural core, and contemporary development. Through field-based practice, students will build an objective, multi‑dimensional, and authentic perception of China, while enhancing their cross‑cultural communication skills for effective study and life in China. Grade Pass/Fail.

MOES 6001.title: Marxism in China and the Contemporary Era
MOES 6001.description: This course provides an in-depth analysis of major contemporary world social issues and hot topics such as international economy, politics, culture, ecological environment, global governance, cutting-edge issues in contemporary science and technology, major contemporary ideological trends and theoretical hotspots, etc., to enhance students' ability to correctly analyze and assess contemporary global issues. Grading Basis: Pass/Fail
